manual: Auto-compaction fires on WINDOW OCCUPANCY, not on a prompt, and the 2026-09-03 attempts showed a tiny `autoCompactWindow` alone does not provoke it (occupancy never left ~45k). This entry instead PACES real occupancy upward: sixteen turns, each reading one 40000-byte file (~10k tokens) in full, so the transcript climbs ~10k per turn toward the 200k window and crosses the auto-compact threshold between turns rather than blowing past the window inside one turn (which is what `context-budget-warning`'s 80000-byte corpus does: it 400s with `terminal_reason: prompt_too_long`). The two goldens are the `system:status` message whose status is `compacting` (START) and the `system:compact_boundary` line (END).
